This file provides Table S5. This is the calculation of the lipid pump following the Tarling et al. (2022) methodology for stratified net tows.

The mean carbon content and lipid fullness of the copepods will be based on species and stage specific values from the LOKI analysis. Only C. glacialis and C. hyperboreus are considered here which matches the size range of the UVP6 image Calanus.
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# Net data
load("data/hydrobios_net_calanus_20260321.RData")

theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))
```

# Get CTD data and average per depth bin
```{r}
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
rm(indiv_traits, volumes.df)
load("data/uvp6_associated_ctd_20260330.RData")

# Add ctd filenames
uvp_net_match <- uvp_net_match %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>%
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
              select(sample_id, ctd_filename))

# Subset the temperature data
ctd_hydrobios <- ctd %>% 
  filter(filename %in% uvp_net_match$ctd_filename) %>% 
  select(filename, station, datetime, pressure, temperature = te90)

rm(ctd, ctd_profiles, temp_profiles, temp_profiles_100, 
   uvp6_ctd_match)

# Calculate the average temperature per hydrobios bin
temperature_hydrobios <- hydrobios.meta %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              select(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
                     station_year, ctd_filename, reg.inuk),
            by = join_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START)) %>% 
  left_join(ctd_hydrobios %>% 
              select(filename, pressure, temperature),
            join_by(ctd_filename == filename,
                    MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH <= pressure,
                    MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH > pressure)) %>% 
  
  group_by(station_year, reg.inuk, STATION_NAME, 
           DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, BOTTOM_DEPTH,
           MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  summarise(temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")

# 2 profiles have no temperature at lowest depths, assign the value of the last depth bin
temperature_hydrobios <- temperature_hydrobios %>% 
  mutate(temperature = if_else(is.na(temperature) & station_year == "AF-23 2023",
                               0.05642188, temperature)) %>% 
  mutate(temperature = if_else(is.na(temperature) & station_year == "D3 2024",
                               -1.69618182, temperature)) 
```

# Establish traits from LOKI images and literature
```{r}
loki.segmentations <- read.csv("data/LOKI_Bourreau_manuscript/merged_LOKI2013_ecotaxa_masks_features.csv") %>% 
 
# match trait names
  mutate(total_carbon = prosome_carbon_volume + total_lipids_ugC/1000,
         lf_carbon = total_lipids_ugC/1000 / total_carbon * 100,
         waxester_carbon = total_lipids_ugC / 1000) %>% 
  select(object_id, object_annotation_category,
         prosome_length_mm = prosome_major_axis_mm,
         prosome_biovolume_mm3 = prosome_volume_mm3,
         structural_carbon_mgC = prosome_carbon_volume,
         waxester_carbon_mgC = waxester_carbon,
         total_carbon_mgC = total_carbon, 
         lf_carbon) %>% 
  mutate(source = "LOKI segmented") %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage = case_when(
    object_annotation_category == 
      "female+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus F",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus C5",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "civstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus C4",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "female+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis F",
    object_annotation_category ==
      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis C5",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "civstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis C4",
    TRUE ~ object_annotation_category ) )

# Calculate average by taxa stage
loki.averages <- loki.segmentations %>% 
  group_by(taxaStage) %>% 
  summarise(across(prosome_length_mm:lf_carbon,
                   \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  select(taxaStage, total_carbon_mgC, waxester_carbon_mgC, lf_carbon, n)

# C.finmarchicus derived from literature (Pata and Hunt 2023) (CV averages from Durazzano & Titocci, 2025 and C&DW of 59% from Pata & Hunt 2023)
Cfin <- data.frame(
  taxaStage = c("Calanus finmarchicus F", "Calanus finmarchicus C5"),
  total_carbon_mgC = c(0.2055, 0.1617), # DW * 0.59 C%DW
  waxester_carbon_mgC = c(0.0885,0.0445) # DW * 0.34 Lipid%DW * 0.81 WE%Lipid
) %>% 
  mutate(lf_carbon = waxester_carbon_mgC / total_carbon_mgC * 100)

Calanus.traits <- bind_rows(loki.averages, Cfin)

rm(loki.segmentations, loki.averages, Cfin)
```

# Calculate traits
```{r}
# Use the stage specific values from LOKI for C. hyperboreus and C. glacialis
bb <- 2.27# Metabolic constant (x 10-7)
eV <- 0.6 # Activation energy

net_traits <- calanus %>% 
  # Add temperature for the bin
  left_join(temperature_hydrobios,
            by = join_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, 
                         MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH)) %>% 
  # Add carbon traits
  mutate(stage = if_else(stage == "M", "F", stage)) %>% # use the F traits for M
  mutate(taxaStage = paste(TAXON_ID, stage)) %>% 
  left_join(Calanus.traits %>% 
              select(-c(lf_carbon, n)), by = join_by(taxaStage)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate respiration and diapause duration
  mutate(temperature_kelvin = temperature + 273.15) %>% 
  mutate(structural_carbon_mgC = total_carbon_mgC - waxester_carbon_mgC) %>% 
  
  # Calculate diapause respiration rate and duration
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon_mgC * 1000,
         WE_ugC = waxester_carbon_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (temperature_kelvin-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*temperature_kelvin*273)) * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*WE_ugC)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) %>% 

  # Cap the diapause duration capped to 240 days
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_cap = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                                240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # The total C respired for the entire duration of diapause by the individual (ug C)
  mutate(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC = 
           respirationRate_ugCday * diapauseDuration_day_cap)
```

# Calculate lipid pump
```{r}
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)
net_lipid_pump <- net_traits %>% 

  # Convert abundance to biomass and respiration by area (m2)
  mutate(biomass_gC_m2 = abundance_m2 * total_carbon_mgC  / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2 = abundance_m2 * structural_carbon_mgC / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2 = abundance_m2 * waxester_carbon_mgC / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2 = abundance_m2 * diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC / 1000 / 1000) %>% 
  
  # Calculate mortality rate
   mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapauseDuration_day_cap)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_gC_m2 - 
           (structural_gC_m2 * mortality.coef)),
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_gC_m2 - 
           (waxester_gC_m2 * mortality.coef))) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + 
           structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  
  # Depth integration
  group_by(reg.inuk, station_year) %>% 
  
  summarise(nNets = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(volume_filtered_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
            structural_gC = sum(structural_gC_m2),
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  left_join(region_rename, by = join_by(reg.inuk))


# Percent of biomass below 200 m 
df.net.200m <- net_traits %>% 
  mutate(biomass_gC_m2 = abundance_m2 * total_carbon_mgC  / 1000) %>% 
  filter(MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH >= 200) %>% 
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(total_200m_biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2, na.rm = T),
           .groups = "drop") %>% 
  full_join(net_lipid_pump %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuk, biomass_gC_m2)) %>% 
  mutate(total_200m_biomass_gC_m2 = coalesce(total_200m_biomass_gC_m2, 
                                             0)) %>% 
  mutate(perc_biomass_200m = total_200m_biomass_gC_m2/
           biomass_gC_m2*100) 


# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
net_lipid_pump_region <- net_lipid_pump %>% 
  left_join(df.net.200m %>% 
              select(station_year, perc_biomass_200m), 
            by = "station_year") %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(c(abundance_m2:frac_waxe_total,perc_biomass_200m),
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

# Table S5. Depth integrated Calanus spp. concentration and annual lipid pump carbon (LPC) flux based on net observations per subregion. 
```{r}
tableS5 <- net_lipid_pump_region %>% 
  # select(region.inuktitut, n, total_gC_flux_m2_mean, total_gC_flux_m2_sd) %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m2 = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",abundance_m2_mean, abundance_m2_sd),
         biomass_gC_m2 = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",biomass_gC_m2_mean, biomass_gC_m2_sd),
         waxester_gC_m2 = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",waxester_gC_m2_mean, waxester_gC_m2_sd),
         total_gC_flux_m2 = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",total_gC_flux_m2_mean, total_gC_flux_m2_sd),
         perc_C_flux = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",fraction_C_flux_mean*100, fraction_C_flux_sd*100),
         perc_respired = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",frac_resp_total_mean*100, 
                                 frac_resp_total_sd*100),
         perc_structural = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",frac_strut_total_mean*100, 
                                 frac_strut_total_sd*100),
         perc_waxester = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",frac_waxe_total_mean*100, 
                                 frac_waxe_total_sd*100),
         perc_biomass_200m = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f", perc_biomass_200m_mean,
                                     perc_biomass_200m_sd)) %>%
  select(region.inuktitut, n,
         abundance_m2, biomass_gC_m2, waxester_gC_m2, 
         total_gC_flux_m2, total_gC_flux_m2_median, perc_C_flux, perc_respired,
         perc_structural, perc_waxester, perc_biomass_200m)
```
